body.message:
Thank you for clarifying. I understand that the deposit has already been refunded to the original card.

However, I am referring to the refund for one additional night due to the issues with the apartment. Since I am no longer in Dubai, I would appreciate it if you could find another way to process this refund.

If you are unable to refund it to the original card, I can provide another international card for the refund.

Please let me know how we can proceed.
